detection: schema must equal planha-canonical-architecture/3.2 and contain planha-architecture-spatial-authority/1.0 plus a non-empty per-consumer engineering authority matrix
affected_claims: courtyard, lightwell and internal void classification
stair, landing, flight and tread/riser recognition
unaffected_claims: existing review decisions whose source and geometry fingerprints remain unchanged
strategy: Regenerate from the exact source. Never project 3.1 geometry or topology booleans into 3.2 authority. Re-annotate the independent Golden schema and require source-handle coverage before a VERIFIED claim.
